workflow_title: Doctrinal Legal Memorandum Drafting (IRAC)
task_input: A concrete fact pattern and a well-defined legal question within a named jurisdiction.
professional_operations: Spot issues and identify governing law; research primary authorities; synthesize rules; apply law to facts issue by issue; draft and bluebook-cite the memo.
expected_deliverable: A structured legal memorandum with question presented, brief answer, facts, analysis, and conclusion, fully cited.
success_criteria: Every issue is addressed, rules are correctly stated and applied to the facts, and all propositions are supported by primary authority.

workflow_title: Federal Legislative History Compilation
task_input: A specific statutory section or public-law citation whose legislative history must be reconstructed.
professional_operations: Identify public-law and bill numbers; locate committee reports, hearings, debates, and signing statements; assemble them in chronological order; annotate each source's relevance.
expected_deliverable: A legislative history report listing and excerpting the key documents in order with citations.
success_criteria: All material legislative-history documents for the provision are located and correctly cited, with no fabricated sources.

workflow_title: Statutory Construction and Interpretation Analysis
task_input: A statutory provision and a fact pattern raising an interpretive question.
professional_operations: Parse statutory text and definitions; assess ambiguity; apply plain-meaning and canons; consult legislative history and precedents; state the controlling interpretation and its consequences.
expected_deliverable: A written interpretation memo stating the operative construction, reasoning, and authority for each step.
success_criteria: The interpretation is textually grounded, consistent with controlling precedent, and each interpretive step is supported by authority.

workflow_title: Precedential Validity Check via Citator (Shepard's/KeyCite)
task_input: A case citation and the narrow proposition for which it is being cited.
professional_operations: Run the citator; review subsequent history and citing decisions; distinguish negative treatment of the case from negative treatment of the specific proposition; note pending cases and jurisdiction.
expected_deliverable: A validity memo stating whether the case and proposition are still good law, with the treatment history summarized and cited.
success_criteria: The good-law determination is correct for the cited proposition and every treatment claim traces to a real subsequent case.

workflow_title: End-to-End E-Discovery Lifecycle (Legal Hold to Production)
task_input: A corpus of potentially relevant ESI plus custodians, date ranges, and the discovery requests or preservation order defining scope.
professional_operations: Identify custodians and data sources; issue and track legal holds; collect with chain of custody; process and normalize into a review platform; cull via search and deduplication; review for responsiveness; produce with Bates numbering and load files.
expected_deliverable: A defensible production set (images or natives, metadata load file, privilege log) plus preservation and collection logs.
success_criteria: All responsive, non-privileged ESI produced within deadlines with intact chain of custody and metadata, defensible against spoliation challenges.

workflow_title: Privilege Review and Privilege Log Generation
task_input: A review population of documents plus defined privilege types (attorney-client, work product) and the negotiated privilege-log field list.
professional_operations: Define privilege codes and criteria; search for attorney-involved communications; apply privilege and type codes across attachment families and email threads; configure withholding rules; emit the privilege log with descriptions.
expected_deliverable: A privilege log spreadsheet listing withheld documents with Bates numbers and privilege descriptions, plus production placeholders for withheld items.
success_criteria: No privileged content is produced, every withheld document appears in the log with a valid description, and all coding is auditable.

workflow_title: Technology-Assisted Review (TAR) Responsiveness and Issue Coding
task_input: A large uncoded document population, issue and responsiveness code definitions, and an initial seed of reviewer-coded examples.
professional_operations: Build a training seed; train the predictive model; rank and prioritize documents; apply suggested codes; sample and validate low-confidence bins; escalate to human QC; produce the validated responsive set.
expected_deliverable: A validated responsive document set with issue codes and a defensibility memo documenting methodology and measured recall and precision.
success_criteria: Recall meets agreed thresholds with documented validation, and the review is defensible under judicial or regulatory scrutiny.

workflow_title: Deposition and Witness Preparation Support
task_input: A deposition notice listing topics, the witness's relevant documents, and the case timeline and issues.
professional_operations: Identify key documents and anchor points; build a chronology; draft the examination outline with exhibit cross-references; assemble exhibit binders; flag impeachment and privilege-sensitive material.
expected_deliverable: A deposition outline with exhibit list, a prepared exhibit binder, and a witness-preparation summary.
success_criteria: Every notice topic is covered, each outline point is anchored to a specific document, and exhibits are correctly ordered and cleared.

workflow_title: Screening mammography interpretation with BI-RADS assessment and MQSA-mandated reporting and patient communication
task_input: Screening mammogram image set with indication and any prior images
professional_operations: Verify image quality and compare with priors; interpret findings on a certified workstation; assign the BI-RADS final assessment category (0-6) and tissue density category; dictate the structured report; issue the lay-summary letter within MQSA deadlines; arrange recall or biopsy communication when suspicious (7-day letter); record audit outcomes for the facility audit
expected_deliverable: Signed structured imaging report with BI-RADS category and density, a patient lay-summary letter, and provider notification when indicated
success_criteria: Correct BI-RADS categorization audited against biopsy outcomes, compliance with MQSA notification deadlines (7 and 30 day rules), interpretable lay letter, facility audit targets met under MQSA oversight

workflow_title: Lung-RADS v2022 category assignment and follow-up management recommendation for lung screening LDCT
task_input: A low-dose CT lung screening study with prior examinations referenced for comparison
professional_operations: Assess technical adequacy; compare with the prior CT and assign category 0 when comparison is unavailable; measure the nodule and characterize features (solid or ground glass, spiculation, lymphadenopathy); assign the Lung-RADS 0 to 4X category plus S modifier; determine the management interval (12-month LDCT, shorter interval LDCT, or diagnostic workup); sign the structured screening report
expected_deliverable: A Lung-RADS structured report with category, modifier, and follow-up management recommendation
success_criteria: Correct category assignment against nodule outcomes, screening program cancer detection targets, and timely recommended follow-up intervals

workflow_title: Synoptic histopathological reporting of breast cancer resection specimens to the RCPath G148 dataset
task_input: A breast surgical resection specimen (lumpectomy or mastectomy) with clinical context and prior biopsy results
professional_operations: Perform gross examination and block taking per protocol; measure and grade the tumour; assess margins, vascular invasion, oestrogen and progesterone receptor and HER2 status; sample lymph nodes; complete the synoptic proforma with the graded core data items; assign TNM8 stage; issue the structured report into the hospital system
expected_deliverable: A synoptic breast pathology report conforming to the G148 core data items with TNM8 stage and SNOMED coding, delivered to the multidisciplinary team
success_criteria: Report contains all mandatory core data items (G148 completeness standard); tumour grade, margins and node status correct as verified by audit and peer review; report available where the multidisciplinary team can act on it

workflow_title: CLIA proficiency testing enrollment, blind sample testing, and performance evaluation for nonwaived laboratory tests
task_input: Shipped PT samples for each regulated analyte plus the event schedule
professional_operations: Enroll and maintain enrollment for each specialty and subspecialty; receive and check the samples; integrate PT samples into routine runs in the same manner as patient specimens; report results to the PT program by the deadline; receive grading; investigate and remediate any failure; retain records for inspection
expected_deliverable: Completed PT event submissions plus a compliant participation record with documented corrective actions
success_criteria: Passing PT scores per analyte per event, for hematology per 42 CFR 493.941 (80 percent consensus, 3 SD differential, 4 percent erythrocyte and hematocrit limits); no unsolved failure; continuously compliant enrollment

workflow_title: Incidental pulmonary nodule risk categorization and follow-up scheduling using the Fleischner Society 2017 guidelines
task_input: A routine chest CT containing an incidentally detected pulmonary nodule
professional_operations: Detect and measure the nodule; classify solid, part-solid or ground-glass morphology; refine patient risk from history (smoking, age, location, spiculation, size); select the recommended follow-up interval or no-follow-up from the Fleischner tables; document findings and recommendation in the report; communicate to the ordering clinician
expected_deliverable: A CT report with the incidental nodule description, risk classification, and the recommended follow-up interval
success_criteria: Recommended interval matches the guideline tables for the measured size and risk class; malignant nodules are not discharged to no-follow-up; benign nodules avoid unnecessary imaging

workflow_title: Radiation therapy physics plan and chart review: initial plan and chart check, weekly check, and end-of-treatment check
task_input: A new draft treatment plan plus the patient chart for the physics review queue
professional_operations: Initial check: verify prescription and authorization, review contours, dose distribution and DVH against constraints, check plan parameters and independent machine data; weekly check: review imaged fractions, shifts, and doses delivered; end-of-treatment check: verify record completeness and write the summary; document every finding and require correction before treatment proceeds
expected_deliverable: A signed physicist review record (initial, weekly, end-of-treatment) with corrections communicated to the treatment team
success_criteria: Plan errors caught before or at the first fraction; zero unreviewed charts; weekly checks documented per policy

workflow_title: Chemotherapy prescribing, order verification, preparation, and administration safety workflow per ASCO/ONS standards
task_input: Physician treatment intent plus the patient chart (pathology, stage, laboratory results)
professional_operations: Verify diagnosis and stage documentation is complete; compute doses (body surface area or AUC); place the order set; pharmacist performs independent verification including a second-person check; compound or dispense with safe-handling practice; nurse verifies patient, regimen, laboratories and administration parameters; administer with a second check; educate the patient; monitor and manage acute…
expected_deliverable: An administered prescribed cycle with complete documentation of checks, doses, and monitoring
success_criteria: No order error reaches the patient; all pre-administration checks documented; charting is complete against the standard items

workflow_title: RECIST 1.1 tumor response assessment: lesion selection, measurement, and response categorization
task_input: The baseline scan with the existing lesion selection plus the current follow-up scan
professional_operations: Review baseline and current scans; confirm the target lesion selection (up to 5 lesions, at most 2 per organ); measure the longest diameters including nodal short axis; compute the sum and percent change; apply new-lesion and non-target progression rules; assign CR, PR, SD or PD; perform the confirmatory scan for CR or PR in non-randomized settings; document the response worksheet
expected_deliverable: A response assessment report with per-lesion measurements, the sum, the percent change, and the RECIST category
success_criteria: Correct category by the published thresholds; measurements consistent with the same-modality same-thickness rules; inter-reader agreement met in audited trial contexts

workflow_title: Multidisciplinary cancer case conference (tumor board): case preparation, presentation, and consensus treatment planning per ACS CoC Standard 2.5
task_input: A tentative list of upcoming analytic cancer cases needing prospective treatment planning
professional_operations: Select and prepare cases with all PHI removed from review documentation; distribute staging, pathology and imaging summaries; hold the conference with required specialty attendance; discuss stage and guideline-based treatment options per case, including genetic testing, clinical research and supportive care where applicable; record the consensus treatment plan prospectively; the coordinator monit…
expected_deliverable: A documented prospective consensus treatment plan per case plus the annual coordinator evaluation of conference performance
success_criteria: At least 15 percent of the analytic caseload presented with at least 80 percent prospective; required specialties represented; documented consensus plans align with evidence-based guidelines

workflow_title: Immunotherapy-related toxicity grading, assessment, and management per the ESMO 2022 clinical practice guideline
task_input: A patient on immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy with a suspected or confirmed immune-related adverse event
professional_operations: Detect and grade the suspected toxicity per organ system; exclude alternative causes per the diagnostic workup; apply the grade-matched management algorithm (observation to high-dose corticosteroids, targeted immunosuppression, checkpoint inhibitor hold or discontinuation); obtain organ-specialist referral per the algorithms; reassess response and taper per schedule; follow to resolution
expected_deliverable: A documented irAE diagnosis with toxicity grade, the applied management plan, and a follow-up schedule
success_criteria: Toxicity grade and management match the ESMO algorithms; severe events receive corticosteroids and specialist referral per grade thresholds without delay; no preventable escalation

workflow_title: Clinical decision support (CDS) selection, implementation, and lifecycle monitoring for health IT-enabled clinical workflows
task_input: CDS request from a clinical service or a detected care gap or alerting problem, with supporting guideline evidence and baseline workflow data.
professional_operations: Review the care gap or safety event and the evidence base; convene multidisciplinary review (clinicians, informatics, IT, quality); select the intervention format using the CDS Five Rights model; author or configure the rule in EHR tooling; test against representative and edge cases; implement with clinician education and change management; evaluate impact with an outcome or eCQM measure; monitor…
expected_deliverable: Configured, tested, go-live CDS intervention with approval documentation, education record, and a monitoring or evaluation plan.
success_criteria: Improved process or outcome measure without new safety events; reduced alert overrides or documented rationale; scheduled governance review performed on time.

workflow_title: Electronic clinical quality measure (eCQM) lifecycle development: conceptualization, specification, testing, and program implementation
task_input: Measure concept from a Call for Measures, stakeholder need, or measurement gap, plus supporting clinical evidence.
professional_operations: Perform environmental scan and evidence review, draft the business case; specify the measure in CQL and HQMF with QDM/QI-Core data elements and VSAC value sets; run iterative testing for reliability, validity, feasibility, and usability including health IT calculation testing (Cypress, BPS, synthetic data); submit through rulemaking and CMS consensus-based entity endorsement; publish annual updat…

success_criteria: Measure passes reliability, validity, feasibility, and usability testing; certified health IT products calculate consistent rates; measure is adopted in program rulemaking and maintained on schedule.

expected_deliverable: Operating XDS.b affinity domain with registry and repositories, conformant member connections, and required ATNA audit trail.
success_criteria: Cross-enterprise query returns valid, retrievable document entries; all transactions pass conformance testing; audit trail satisfies ATNA requirements.

task_input: Daily refreshed BioSense Platform data plus situational requests (mass gatherings, disasters, respiratory season monitoring).
professional_operations: Maintain platform access through the site administrator; define categorical syndrome subsets and query library for the jurisdiction; review dashboards and alerts on a daily schedule; run ESSENCE queries against expected baselines to detect aberrations; investigate signals (clustering by location, severe symptoms, unexplained deaths, simultaneous multi-source alerts); pursue diagnostic confirmatio…
expected_deliverable: Daily situational awareness products; investigated and dispositioned alert records; event-related syndromic summaries; periodic reports of trends; documentation of syndrome definitions used.
success_criteria: Aberrations are detected in near real-time (data within 24 hours of visits); alerts are triaged and dispositioned with documented rationale; detected signals contribute to earlier investigation or response; monitoring continuity documented…

workflow_title: BRFSS annual prevalence estimation: weighted analysis of the complex-survey public-use data file
task_input: BRFSS annual public-use data plus an analytic request (target indicators, geographic units, and population subgroups).
professional_operations: Download the data file, codebook, and variable layout; read and validate the fixed-position data; map variables and recode to analytic measures; build derived/calculated variables per documentation; declare the complex survey design with the raked weight (_LLCPWT) and strata; compute weighted prevalence and design-based confidence intervals for target indicators and subgroups; apply post-2011 com…
expected_deliverable: Weighted prevalence estimates and design-based confidence intervals in tabular/report form; methodology documentation; monitoring briefs or public dashboards for health policy audiences.

workflow_title: Clinical trial site monitoring visits with source data verification (SDV)

success_criteria: No unresolved critical findings at database lock; SDV coverage meets the monitoring plan; query resolution before lock per med_trials_wf02 gates; visit reports filed on schedule; protocol-deviation trends within acceptable limits across si…

workflow_title: 政策影响评估的倍差法（DID）设计、识别与估计工作流
task_input: 项目文件集 + 面板/重复截面数据 + 抽样权重与代码簿 + 变革理论与结果指标规格 + 政策前/后时间窗界定
professional_operations: ①建立变革理论与结果指标体系（手冊章2 的 M&E 框架与基線设计）；②对照 RCT/匹配/IV/RD 的适用条件与方法优劣表选择 DID（章2 反事实逻辑、章10 方法比较）；③确认数据形态：面板或『组成保持稳定』的重复截面（章5 原句），界定处理/对照 × 前/后四群组；④指定模型 DD=E(Y1T−Y0T|T1=1)−E(Y1C−Y0C|T1=0)，多期扩展为面板固定效应模型 Yit=αTit+Xitβ+μi+εit（章5）；⑤逐条检验识别假设并点名：平行趋势（p.73 三条件之三，含 Cov(εit,Ti1t)=0；绘趋势图+前趋势检验）——即 DID 语境的 'unconfoundedness' 形态；时不变未观测异质性（章5 原句）；无同期混淆冲击；组组成稳定；SUTVA/无溢出（章3 溢出案例的反面教材）；⑥估计 DID 系数，按处理单元层级聚类计算稳健标准误与置信区间；若…
expected_deliverable: 影响评估报告/政策备忘录：变革理论与指标图、基线与平行趋势图、DID 估计表（系数+聚类SE+CI+样本量）、识别假设逐条判断表（含加权/未加权口径）、稳健性检验、局限与政策結論
success_criteria: ①基線期前趋势检验不拒绝平行趋势（无系统斜差且事后检验标注）；②估计表含四群组均值、DID 系数、聚类 SE 与 90/95% CI，可独立復算；③识别假设逐条有数据或设计论据支持的书面判断；④政策結論与系数大小、置信区间一致，统计不显著时如实表述；⑤方法节点名全部关键假设。

workflow_title: AEA 复制包（Replication Package）合规核查与复现验证工作流
task_input: 复制包 + 论文 exhibits + Data and Code Availability Form + 可运行计算环境；执行者为期刊侧复现专员
professional_operations: ①按 Preparing-your-files-for-verification 文档核查包结构与 README 必需要素：数据来源与获取方式、计算要求、运行说明、预期输出与时长（DCAS #13）；②核查数据引用完整性与 Data Availability Statement 一致性（DCAS #6/#1），含代码完整性（'including code to read in raw data, even when the data cannot be provided'）；③在受限环境按 README 顺序重执行整套代码（raw data 读入→转换→分析→图表），采集每步退出码、运行时长、输出文件；④将输出与论文 exhibits 逐一比对（数值/图形 diff），形成逐表逐图的复现矩阵（成功/容差内偏差/失败+原因）；⑤核查许可、开放格式与披露要求（DCAS #4/#11 伦理批准…
expected_deliverable: 复现报告（逐表逐图复现状态+偏差说明+修正要求）+ 合规核查清单 + 通过验证的复制包最终存檔（README、LICENSE、数据可得性声明齐备）与 DOI 引用记录
success_criteria: ①论文全部图表均有复现判定（成功/容差内偏差/失败+原因）；②README 模板必需要素覆盖 100%（逐条勾稽）；③包内转换/分析/图表代码全部被执行且输出匹配；④验证终态以复现报告为客观载体，由数据编辑办公室决定接受或退回修订。

workflow_title: 基于联合国指南的分层多阶段整群家户调查抽样设计工作流
task_input: 抽样框表+地图、上轮调查数据、问卷草稿、精度与估计域需求说明书
professional_operations: ①界定调查目标、目标总体、估计域（domains）与关键指标的精度/置信度要求；②评估数据源与抽样框（手册 1.2：普查/行政记录/新列表），核查覆盖与更新（含 area sampling 概念）；③按 3.4 设计分层（显式+隐式分层的规则与跨层分配），3.5 确定整群与第一阶段抽样单元（PSU）；④第一阶段按 PPS（度量=人口/住户规模测度）或 PPES 抽选 PSU（3.7.1/3.7.2），后续阶段按系统抽样抽取次级/最终单元，方案选项（Epsem/PPS/固定等）按 3.8 与精度-成本权衡确定；⑤按 3.3.10 计算样本量：关键估计式 × 设计效应（deff/deft，3.3.5）→ 按预期无响应率上调（3.3.6）→ 按域内需求分配；⑥构建加权重构方案：基础权重（选择概率倒数）→ 无响应调整 → 其他校准（5.5：'base weights, non-response …
expected_deliverable: 抽样设计技术文档：分层与域规格、每阶段选择概率与抽选步骤（含随机种子）、样本量表（关键指标 SE/CV、deff、无响应假设）、权重计算规则、方差估计方案、质量保证清单（覆盖率/无响应跟踪点）
success_criteria: ①关键指标的设计 SE/CV 达委托方精度要求且可由方案独立复算；②每阶段选择概率可追溯、抽选可重现（固定种子）；③权重和≈目标总体规模、权重构成逻辑自洽（基础→无响应→校准可拆解）；④第三方按文档能重放抽选并复算样本量与权重（文档自足性检验）；⑤无响应与覆盖测量点在方案中明示阈值。

workflow_title: 按 CRISP-DM 六阶段的客户流失预测建模与业务部署工作流
task_input: 去标识化的客户特征与标签数据集、流失窗口定义、模型与阈值要求
professional_operations: 1）业务理解：定义流失事件与干预成本矩阵；2）数据理解：质量审计与特征字典；3）数据准备：清洗、特征工程、处理类别不平衡；4）建模：基线加梯度提升等算法与超参选择；5）评估：交叉验证、AUC/收益曲线与业务干预模拟；6）部署：评分管道、阈值制定与监控设计
expected_deliverable: 流失预测模型包：特征管道、评估报告（AUC、lift、收益曲线）与部署监控方案
success_criteria: 留出集 AUC 与提升曲线超过提前约定的基线；评分管道可经第二实现复现；全部评估与结论可追溯至去标识化数据版本

workflow_title: 按 FPP3 方法的经营时间序列预测与区间评估工作流（销售/需求预测）
task_input: 目标序列（含时间索引）与预测时段长度、频率
professional_operations: 1）图形探索与 STL 分解识别趋势、季节性与异常；2）建立朴素/均值基线；3）拟合 ETS 与 ARIMA（含自动选择）并做残差诊断（Ljung-Box、白噪声）；4）生成点预测与 80%/95% 预测区间；5）滚动原点回测并计算 RMSE/MAE/MASE 等精度指标；6）汇总预测假设与不确定性说明
expected_deliverable: 预测报告：图表、模型选择理由、区间预测、回测精度表与业务建议
success_criteria: 回测指标优于约定基准（如 MASE 小于 1）；时间序列交叉验证经第二实现复现；区间覆盖率接近名义水平

workflow_title: 基于统计欺诈检测框架的交易异常检测工作流（Bolton & Hand 监督+无监督双轨）
task_input: 交易数据集（金额、时间、渠道、商户等去标识字段）与复核人力额度
professional_operations: 1）特征化交易（频率、金额分布、时段、地理）；2）构建监督模型（逻辑回归/集成）与无监督筛查（孤立森林、聚类离群）；3）叠加专家规则并做分数融合；4）按风险分排序并设定复核队列阈值；5）用样本外与时间外验证评估检出率/误报率；6）输出监控报告与复核队列
expected_deliverable: 欺诈评分管道、阈值设定记录、验证报告（检出率、误报率、收益曲线）与复核队列
success_criteria: 时间外验证检出率与误报率在约定阈值内；评分可复现；规则与模型贡献可解释

workflow_title: 按 OFAC 合规承诺框架的制裁名单筛查与命中处置工作流（SDN 名单 + 50% 规则）
task_input: 目标名单批量（脱敏或合成姓名/实体清单）与上游 SDN 数据版本
professional_operations: 1）下载解析最新 SDN 名单（含别名与地址字段）；2）规范化姓名与实体内字段；3）执行精确匹配与近似匹配（编辑距离/转写/别名）；4）按 50% 规则核查被筛出实体与名单实体的所有权关联；5）对命中项置入冻结/审批与潜在申报队列；6）记录筛查日志并更新程序文档
expected_deliverable: 筛查运行报告：命中清单（含匹配强度与名单条目引用）、处置建议与程序留痕
success_criteria: 构造的命中/非命中测试集零漏报（注入名单项 100% 检出）且误报率可接受；匹配强度与名单版本可追溯；50% 规则判定有文档依据

workflow_title: 按 31 CFR 1010.210 四大支柱的金融机构反洗钱（AML）计划评估与年度合规程序
task_input: 机构风险画像要素（脱敏或合成）与法规条款集、监管检查清单条目
professional_operations: 1）按 1010.210 四大支柱梳理现行程序；2）建立客户/产品/地域/渠道风险分类矩阵；3）将 CDD、监控与申报义务映射到程序文件与职责表；4）设计独立测试方案与员工培训矩阵；5）评估程序缺口并生成整改清单；6）形成年度 AML 计划文档与董事会报告框架
expected_deliverable: AML 计划文件包：风险评估矩阵、政策程序对照表、测试与培训矩阵、整改清单
success_criteria: 四大支柱覆盖矩阵无缺口；每项程序映射到法规条款；风险矩阵与后续监控触发条件一致

workflow_title: 按 FinCEN 申报说明的可疑活动报告（SAR）编制与电子报送工作流
task_input: 一个可疑活动案例材料（合成或授权）：主体信息、交易序列、调查结论
professional_operations: 1）核对监控命中与补充调查信息的完整性；2）按说明填报主体、分支机构、账户与交易字段；3）撰写事实叙述（何人何时何处何事何额五要素）；4）内部复核与审批；5）经 BSA 电子申报系统提交；6）归档与保密管理并按说明保留记录
expected_deliverable: 填写完成的 SAR 表单草稿（含叙述段落）与提交归档清单
success_criteria: 全部必填字段符合申报说明的格式与字段规范；叙述采用事实语言并覆盖五要素；在 30 天时限与保密要求下完成流程

workflow_title: 按 31 CFR 1010.230 的法人客户受益所有人识别与客户尽职调查（CDD）程序
task_input: 一个法人实体的名称、注册文件与股权结构信息（合成或授权脱敏）
professional_operations: 1）收集与尽调标准一致的法人登记文件；2）按股权（25% 以上）与控制两要件识别受益所有人与控制人；3）用认证表核验身份并留存认证表（附录 A 格式）与身份信息；4）评估客户风险等级并联动加强尽调触发；5）建档并设置持续复核周期；6）输出尽调结论与缺口处置
expected_deliverable: CDD 档案：股权结构图、受益所有人判定记录、认证表核验结果、风险等级结论
success_criteria: 受益所有人识别覆盖规则要求的全部层叠与控制路径；判定可由第二人按文件复核一致；档案满足记录保存要求

workflow_title: 按巴塞尔 FRTB 标准的交易台损益归因（P&L Attribution/PLA）检验与内部模型资本审批工作流
task_input: 交易台授权 HPL/RTPL 日度序列（覆盖至少一个监测期）、适用的 FRTB 版本条款、阈值参数（Spearman 0.8、KS 双侧 95%、红区计数规则）
professional_operations: 1）按 FRTB 定义核对 HPL 与 RTPL 口径（估值调整、当日新交易与过期交易处理）；2）计算月度 Spearman 相关系数（阈 0.8）并执行 KS 双侧 95% 分布检验；3）按绿/黄/红区间标准逐月判定；4）跨 12 个月滚动统计红区频次并评估退出内部模型法后果；5）产出检验台账、结论与处置建议
expected_deliverable: 交易台 P&L 归因检验报告：指标计算明细、绿黄红分区判定、12 个月红区滚动统计、内部模型资本可用性结论与处置建议
success_criteria: Spearman 与 KS 计算值经双实现比对一致；分区判定与 BCBS 457 条款映射表逐条可溯源且合成数据边界用例全部通过；12 个月滚动监测程序可重复复现相同判定序列

workflow_title: 基于 Deflated Sharpe Ratio 的策略回测过拟合校正与绩效诚实披露工作流
task_input: 回测得到的 Sharpe 序列或候选策略收益、试验次数 N、收益偏度峰度估计、显著性目标（默认 95%）、样本内外划分规则
professional_operations: 1）登记策略发现全程试验盘（明确 N 与多重检验结构）；2）估计 SR 分布的偏度与峰度并构建非正态推断（PSR）；3）依论文封闭解计算 N 次试验下的期望最大 SR_0；4）计算 Deflated Sharpe Ratio 并按概率判定策略是否真实优于基准；5）执行样本内外划分与 walk-forward 复核；6）撰写含过拟合警示与披露口径的评估报告
expected_deliverable: 策略评估报告：各策略 DSR/PSR 值、试验次数与多重检验清单、样本内/样本外对比、含回测局限声明的绩效披露口径
success_criteria: 全部候选策略 DSR 按论文公式复算与原文数值示例一致；样本外表现与校正后预期一致；报告中包含重复使用同一数据源的过拟合风险披露且未挑选试验记录；披露口径避免误导性样本内业绩展示

workflow_title: 按 GIPS 2020 标准的量化策略 Composite 业绩构建与展示合规工作流
task_input: 组合日度现金流/估值主体数据、composite 定义与自由裁量归属期、费用与杠杆参数、展示期间（1/3/5/10 年）与已有 presentation 模板
professional_operations: 1）按 GIPS 2020 划定 Composite 并执行自由裁量组合的归属与排除记录；2）选择现金流加权方法（modified Dietz 或日权重法）计算组合及 composite 回报；3）生成毛额/净额、杠杆与外包披露对应的各期间年化业绩；4）编制覆盖全部强制披露条款的 presentation 并做内部一致性校验；5）按验证者程序组织支持性文件与抽查应答并回填发现项
expected_deliverable: GIPS 合规 composite presentation（计算说明与强制披露齐备）、内部一致性校验报告、验证支持文件包与发现项回填记录
success_criteria: presentation 覆盖 GIPS 2020 全部强制披露条款且一致性校验零错误；composite 回报与独立复算一致（含费用口径差异说明）；每条计算可追溯到源记录；示例 composite 演示满足展示要求清单

workflow_title: 交易所市场数据许可合规盘点：使用场景分级、费用申报与再分发边界核验工作流
task_input: 使用场景台账、交易所政策条款文本（人工提供 PDF/摘录）、分类规则（Display/Non-Display、内部/外部、费率层级）与合同要点
professional_operations: 1）建立使用场景台账并逐项取证（应用清单与终端位置）；2）按政策将各场景归入 Display/Non-Display 与内部/外部类别；3）梳理下游再分发路径并逐条核验是否属于许可范围；4）依费率层级测算应付费用并与现有合同比对；5）生成合规差距清单并标注整改建议；6）归档形成年度复核底稿
expected_deliverable: 行情使用合规清单、费用测算与合同比对表、合规差距与整改追踪表、年度复核底稿
success_criteria: 台账经抽查覆盖全部已知行情使用点零遗漏；每个场景分类可回溯至政策原文条款；费用测算与官方费率表一致且差异逐项有解释；差距项均有整改责任人；Agent 与专员双盲抽样分类结果达成一致
